description: U.S. EPA Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program Coal Mine Methane 2011-2024 is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Elise Penn. Mirror of tables provided by the United States (U.S.) Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program (GHGRP) related to coal mine methane emission from 2011 through 2024. Table code is FF. Tables included: Downloaded from the EnviroFacts API (https://www.epa.gov/enviro/envirofacts-data-service-api) using a fork of GHGRP-for-Energy (https://github.com/pennelise/GHGRP_for_Energy) in December 2024. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. Formats: CSV. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0 1.0. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support industrial-facility and resource studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
